description: The ten nominations that settled under slow mode at the tail of the 2025 auction, after the live session ended and a 13.3-hour overnight gap. This is the COMPLETENESS AND SETTLEMENT corpus, not a pricing one: nine of the ten drew a single bidding team and every one sold for $0-2, so it is evidence that an eligible set completes and the player settles to the right team at the right price. It is the only production evidence completeness-based settlement has. A failure here is a settlement-mechanics failure; pricing is the separate 300-player corpus.
source: league_production, league 1, season 2025, AUCTION_PROCESSED sales 35 through 44 in occurrence order
boundary: The slow-mode tail begins at sale 35. Sales 1-34 ran live in about an hour; the gap between sale 34 and sale 35 is 13h 17m, and slow mode was enabled during it to finish the outstanding nominations.
relationship_to_pricing_corpus: These ten are a SUBSET of auction-second-price-replay-2021-2025.json, not independent of it, so a divergence here is also a divergence there. They are wired as a separate gate anyway, because the claim under test is different: this one is about completeness and settlement, that one is about price.
derivation:
with sales as (
  select pid, tid, player_salary, occurred_at,
    row_number() over (order by occurred_at, transaction_id) as seq
  from transactions
  where lid = 1 and type = 7 and season_year = 2025
),
tail as (
  select seq, pid, tid as actual_winner_tid, player_salary as actual_price, occurred_at as settled_at
  from sales where seq between 35 and 44
),
bids as (
  select b.pid, b.tid, b.player_salary as amount, b.occurred_at, b.transaction_id
  from transactions b
  join tail t on t.pid = b.pid
  where b.lid = 1 and b.type = 6 and b.season_year = 2025
),
opening as (
  select distinct on (pid) pid, tid as nominating_team_id, amount as opening_bid
  from bids order by pid, occurred_at, transaction_id
),
team_max as (
  select distinct on (pid, tid) pid, tid, amount as maximum_bid, occurred_at as amount_set_at
  from bids order by pid, tid, amount desc, occurred_at, transaction_id
)
select json_agg(rec order by seq) as nominations from (
  select t.seq,
    json_build_object(
      'sale_sequence', t.seq,
      'pid', t.pid,
      'settled_at', to_char(t.settled_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
      'nominating_team_id', o.nominating_team_id,
      'opening_bid', o.opening_bid,
      'claims', json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'tid', tm.tid,
          'maximum_bid', tm.maximum_bid,
          'amount_set_at', to_char(tm.amount_set_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
        ) order by tm.maximum_bid desc, tm.amount_set_at, tm.tid
      ),
      'actual_winner_tid', t.actual_winner_tid,
      'actual_price', t.actual_price
    ) as rec
  from tail t
  join opening o on o.pid = t.pid
  join team_max tm on tm.pid = t.pid
  group by t.seq, t.pid, t.settled_at, t.actual_winner_tid, t.actual_price,
    o.nominating_team_id, o.opening_bid
) grouped
